identity.title: Aim to Be a Card Master!!

source.sourceCategory: Category:Aim to Be a Card Master!!

leadText: Mezase!! Card Master (Japanese: めざせ！！　カードマスター Aim to Be a Card Master) is a one-volume manga series drawn by Interu (印照) that was published in Japan only in December 2000. The manga features a young boy named Kenta Minamii, who aims to become a champion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.The series focuses on the many Trading Card Game matches he has while on his quest. It is especially notable for taking place in the real world, rather than the Pokémon world or the Trading Card Game Islands.
plainText:
Mezase!! Card Master (Japanese: めざせ！！　カードマスター Aim to Be a Card Master) is a one-volume manga series drawn by Interu (印照) that was published in Japan only in December 2000. The manga features a young boy named Kenta Minamii, who aims to become a champion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.The series focuses on the many Trading Card Game matches he has while on his quest. It is especially notable for taking place in the real world, rather than the Pokémon world or the Trading Card Game Islands.

==Publications==
The entire series was released as one collected volume.

 
 

==List of chapters==
Battle 1: District Convention "Kenta, to the Open Sea"
Battle 2: Cross-Cultural Battle "The Golden-Haired Lady"
Battle 3: Brothers Face Off "Familiar Rivals"
Battle 4: The Spring World Challenge (Part One) "A New Formidable Rival!?"
Battle 5: The Spring World Challenge (Part Two) "The Girl Who's Too Calm"
Battle 6: The Spring World Challenge (Part Three) "The Secret Plan"
Battle 7: The Summer World Challenge (Part One) "The Prelude to the Decisive Battle"
Battle 8: The Summer World Challenge (Part Two) "Reunion at the Coliseum"
Battle 9: The Summer World Challenge (Part Three) "The Road to Being a Card Master"

==Trivia==

The decks and strategies shown in the series were quite similar to popular ones used by real-life Pokémon Trading Card Game competitive players at the time.
